missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Огонь' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'горит'. 'Яркий' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'в камине' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Огонь' is the accusative direct object of 'развели'; this inanimate masculine noun looks like the nominative. 'Туристы' is the plural subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Огня' is the genitive form required by 'от'. Note the dropped 'о' in the stem, and 'жар' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Огню' is the dative form after 'радовались', the thing the children were glad of. 'Тёплому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Огнём' is the instrumental form after 'перед', expressing position in front. 'Мы' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В огне' uses the prepositional form 'огне' after 'в' to express location. 'Письма' is the neuter plural subject.

missions.phrase: Без огня в лесу темно и холодно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Огня' is the genitive form required by 'без', dropping the stem vowel. The phrase describes the campsite without fire.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Огонь' is the nominative subject of 'распространился'. 'По дому' is the dative complement showing the spread.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Огни' is the nominative plural subject of 'светятся'. 'Большого города' is the genitive complement, and 'красиво' adds manner.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Огню' is the dative form after 'к', marking movement toward the fire. 'Близко' adds proximity to the warning.
